payload.title: File:Xenodontolacerta fangi (holotype, cranial details).png
payload.artist_html: J. Jiang, L.-P. Dong, X. Xu, A. Bi, & S. Evans
payload.credit_html: "A new polyglyphanodontian lizard from the Upper Cretaceous of southern China implies a complex evolutionary history of the clade"
payload.description_html: Detailed cranial morphology of the holotype (CVEB20180206) of Xenodontolacerta fangi. (a) Dorsal view of the skull, (b) left lateral view of the skull and (c) close-up of the anteroventral margin of the orbit. ju, jugal; la, lacrimal; mx, maxilla; pmx, premaxilla; pob, postorbital; pof, postfrontal; par, parietal; prf, prefrontal; sq, squamosal. * indicates the lateral flaring of the ventral margin of the surangular.
